@graph.description: Household goods, estate contents, and commercial inventory stored in sealed wooden vaults — standard vault 5' × 7' × 7'–7'10", 200+ cu. ft., Klimp-fastened knockdown plywood with 4-way forklift entry — loaded once, pad-wrapped, banded, sealed, and inventoried, then stacked in the company's warehouses at Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV. The full stack: storing, loading, unloading and placement, vault delivery and pickup, warehouse-to-warehouse transfers, vaults built and supplied to other movers and operators through the company's custom crating operation, and contract crews to build, load, band, and unload vaults. Military non-temporary storage in sealed wooden vaults, approved and verified through the company's partners. Export liftvans built to the ISPM-15 standard, the only standard the company uses. Storage in leased space, 30-day minimum, customer access, quoted per job, monthly, or by volume at one flat rate in writing.

process.detail: Goods are pad-wrapped and loaded into the vault at the residence, dock, or warehouse — one load, inventoried piece by piece as it goes in.
The loaded vault is banded and sealed against its inventory, so what was loaded once is what is delivered — no re-handling in between.
Sealed vaults are stacked by forklift (4-way entry) in the Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV warehouses, in leased space with customer access, 30-day minimum.
Vaults are delivered to and picked up from sites, and loaded vaults move warehouse to warehouse for staged and phased work.
At delivery the seal is broken, the vault is unloaded against its inventory, and goods are placed where the client directs — the one-touch pair to the load.

The company's custom crating operation builds Klimp-fastened knockdown plywood vaults and supplies them to other movers and operators; contract crews build, load, band, and unload vaults for other operators.
